note: The conservation step `heights` has error `O(W^2)` with no `λ^δ` loss (the remainders `DB`, `DC` are bounded by `accounts_cost` without `δ`), which is stronger than [M]'s `O_δ(λ^δ W^2)`; the final `d_0` bound is the same.

lemma heights (i : Axis) (w) (a) (Z C U : TestMap) (hh : U=Pmul 2 i Z+C) (k : ℕ) (p : ℝ) (f r) (hc : Ach (update w i a) r C) :
    Budget ((-a)*(2*(k+1):ℕ)+r) (fun n => cabin U (k+1) a w f i p n-p^2*cabin Z k a w f i p n) := by

proof_context.conclusion: From `U = Pmul 2 i Z + C` with `C` of cost `Ach r`, `cabin U (k+1) - p^2 * cabin Z k` is `Budget (-a*2(k+1)+r)`, i.e. `c_{r+1}(t) = t^2 c_r(t) + O(W^2)` for the laws `BL_law`, `CL_law`.

lemma rift (i : Axis) (w) (T : TestMap) (x a) (k : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ 0) (hp : Quest (update w i 0) i (fun _ => false) x T) (f : Grouping) (hf : ∀ j,Ends (f j)) (he : ∀ j,j≠i → Reflects false (f j)) (m) :
    Budget (-a*(2*k:ℕ)+(2*a+x))
      (fun n => hole T m k a w f i n - (cabin T k a w f i 1 n - cabin T k a w f i 2 n)) := by

proof_context.conclusion: `hole T m k a w f i n - (cabin T k a w f i 1 n - cabin T k a w f i 2 n)` is `Budget (-a*2k + 2a + x)`, i.e. `d_r = c_r(1) - c_r(2) + O(λ^δ W^2)`.

proof_context.conclusion: For the corrected profile, `hole (SelfB R i) ≥ 0`, `hole (BL R i) ≤ 0`, `hole (CL R i) ≥ 0` (`d_0 ≥ 0`, `d_1 ≤ 0`, `d_2 ≥ 0`), with `hole (SelfB R i) = toll * ∫ ..` by reflection positivity.

lemma budget_lock (x : ℝ) (a b v V r R f g h : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hv : Budget x (fun n => v n-a n)) (hV : Budget x (fun n => V n-4*b n))
    (hr : Budget x (fun n => r n-v n)) (hR : Budget x (fun n => R n-4*V n))
    (hh : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, 0 ≤ f n ∧ g n ≤ 0 ∧ 0≤ h n)
    (he : Budget x (fun n => f n - (a n-b n)))
    (hu : Budget x (fun n => g n - (v n-V n)))

proof_context.conclusion: From the relations `v≈a`, `V≈4b`, `r≈v`, `R≈4V`, `f≈a-b`, `g≈v-V`, `h≈r-R` and the signs `f≥0, g≤0, h≥0`, `f` is `Budget x`: the linear lock `4d_0 = 5d_1 - d_2 + error` forces `d_0` small.

have hCash : Budget (δ+a*2) (hole M m 0 a w f i) := by
    have hp p : Budget (δ+a*2) (fun n => cabin N 1 a w f i p n - p^2 * cabin M 0 a w f i p n) :=
      (heights i w a M (DB F i) N (BL_law hI i) 0 p f _ hE).rise (by push_cast; linarith)
    have ht' p : Budget (δ+a*2) (fun n => cabin L 2 a w f i p n - p^2 * cabin N 1 a w f i p n) :=
      (heights i w a N (DC F i) L (CL_law hI i) 1 p f _ hL).rise (by push_cast; linarith)
    apply budget_lock (δ+a*2) (cabin M 0 a w f i 1) (cabin M 0 a w f i 2) (cabin N 1 a w f i 1) (cabin N 1 a w f i 2)
      (cabin L 2 a w f i 1) (cabin L 2 a w f i 2) (hole M m 0 a w f i) (hole N m 1 a w f i) (hole L m 2 a w f i)
    · simpa using hp 1
    · convert hp 2 using 1; norm_num
    · simpa using ht' 1
    · convert ht' 2 using 1; norm_num
    · exact Eventually.of_forall fun n => (h n).2.2
    · exact (rift i w _ δ a 0 ht B f hG (fun j _ => hT j) m).rise (by push_cast; linarith)
    · exact (rift i w _ (δ+a+a) a 1 ht Y f hG (fun j _ => hT j) m).rise (by push_cast; linarith)
    · exact (rift i w _ (δ+a+a+a+a) a 2 ht Z f hG (fun j _ => hT j) m).rise (by push_cast; linarith)

proof_context.conclusion: `hole (SelfB F i) m 0 a w f i` is `Budget (δ+a*2)`, i.e. `d_0 = O(λ^δ W^2)`.
